title: Bitsocial React Hooks
summary: Bitsocial React Hooks is the React hooks and Zustand store package for building Bitsocial clients.
notes: This is a package/library repo, so README.md, src exports, tests, and package manifests are source of truth.
Hooks are thin selectors around Zustand stores; data flow belongs in stores and protocol clients.
Generated llms files are compiled context for AI contributors, not API authority.
